claim: Visitors step through the photos at their own pace.
Each is shown wide, at a 16 by 9 shape, with its caption underneath and Previous and Next buttons below that.
Up to twenty photos share the one spot, and Next on the last photo takes a visitor back to the first.
Editors add a Slideshow block from Layout Builder, the page builder.
You name the slideshow, and screen readers read that name out.
For every slide you upload an image and describe it in a few words.
A caption is optional, and so is a link, whose label and address have to be filled in together.
Tick Advance automatically and the slides move on every five seconds, with a Pause button for visitors.
If a visitor's device asks for reduced motion, the slideshow starts paused and they can press Resume.
